props.name: defaultIterations
props.description: Escape-time iterations per pixel when it first renders. The slider changes it after that.

props.name: defaultJuliaConstant
props.description: The constant c the Julia set is drawn for, until one is picked from the Mandelbrot view.

props.name: onJuliaConstantChange
props.description: Called when a new Julia constant is picked.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the canvas, in pixels. The width fills the container.
